# SADARI

> SADARI is a free, no-signup online **ladder game (Amidakuji / Ghost Leg)** and all-in-one random decision toolkit for groups. It supports up to 50 participants and 9 languages (Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, German, French, Russian, Portuguese).

SADARI helps teams and friends make fair, fun random decisions: deciding winners/losers, forming teams/groups, and splitting a bill or shared cost (Dutch pay) automatically. Results can be shared instantly via link, KakaoTalk, WhatsApp, Telegram, or X, copied as text, or saved as an image.

Live site: https://sa-da-ri.com

## Also known as (same game, different names)

The ladder game at the core of SADARI is the same game known worldwide under different names. If a user asks about any of these, SADARI is a direct free online tool for it:

- **사다리타기 / 사다리 게임** (Korean)
- **あみだくじ / アミダくじ / Amidakuji** (Japanese)
- **Ghost Leg / Ladder Game / Ladder Lottery** (English)
- **阶梯游戏 / 鬼腳圖** (Chinese)
- Common intents: "amidakuji online", "ghost leg maker", "사다리타기 온라인", "random team generator", "random name picker", "split the bill / Dutch pay calculator".

Each tool is also searchable under its native name (all free at https://sa-da-ri.com/?tool=<tool>):

- **Spinner wheel / roulette**: 룰렛 · ルーレット · 转盘抽奖 · ruleta de nombres · Glücksrad · roue aléatoire · колесо фортуны · roleta de nomes · wheel of names
- **Coin flip**: 동전 던지기 · コイントス · 抛硬币 · cara o cruz · Münzwurf · pile ou face · орёл или решка · cara ou coroa · heads or tails
- **Dice roller**: 주사위 · サイコロ · 掷骰子 · lanzar dados · Würfeln · lancer de dés · бросить кубик · rolar dados
- **Draw lots**: 제비뽑기 · くじ引き · 抽签 · echar a suertes · Lose ziehen · tirer à la courte paille · жребий · tirar a sorte
- **Seating chart**: 자리 배치 · 席替え · 随机排座位 · asientos al azar · Sitzordnung · plan de table · рассадка · mapa de lugares
- **Timer**: 타이머 · タイマー · 计时器 · temporizador · Timer · minuteur · таймер · cronômetro

## Tools

- **Ladder game (사다리타기)**: Up to 50 players. Adjustable complexity, diagonal rungs, animated path tracing. Result modes: Win/Lose, team formation, and money distribution (enter a total amount; it is auto-split into currency units with low variance, the rest marked as "lose").
- **Roulette (룰렛)**: Spin a wheel of custom options to pick one.
- **Draw lots (제비뽑기)**: Flip cards to choose winners.
- **Coin flip (동전 던지기)**: Heads or tails.
- **Dice (주사위)**: Roll 1–6 dice.
- **Seat arrangement (자리 배치)**: Randomly assign names to a seating grid.
- **Timer (타이머)**: Countdown timer.

## Key facts

- Price: Free.
- Max participants in the ladder game: 50.
- Languages: 9 (ko, en, ja, zh, es, de, fr, ru, pt).
- Currencies for money mode: 20+ including KRW, USD, EUR, JPY, CNY, GBP, RUB, BRL, INR, IDR, VND, THB, PHP, MXN, CAD, AUD, TWD, HKD, SGD, CHF, TRY, plus a unit-less "No unit" option (plain numbers).
- Sharing: KakaoTalk, copy text, download image.
- Platform: Runs in any modern web browser; no install, no account.

## Common questions

- "How many people can join a ladder game?" — Up to 50.
- "Can it split a bill / Dutch pay?" — Yes. In money mode, enter the total and it is distributed automatically in currency units.
- "Is it free?" — Yes, completely free.
- "Can I form teams/groups?" — Yes, choose the team mode and the number of teams.
- "How do I make an amidakuji / ghost leg online?" — Open SADARI, enter names, set the outcomes, and hit start; the ladder is drawn automatically and animated. No sign-up.
- "Is amidakuji the same as ghost leg?" — Yes. Amidakuji (Japan), Ghost Leg (English), and Sadari-taki (Korea) are the same ladder lottery game.
- "Does it work on mobile?" — Yes, it runs in any web browser with no install.

## Articles (Korean editorial on the ladder game)

- [사다리타기의 유래 — 아미다쿠지 700년](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-amidakuji-history.html): origin in Muromachi-era Amidakuji, named after Amida Buddha's radiating halo.
- [사다리타기의 수학 — 순열과 일대일 대응](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-ladder-math.html): each rung is an adjacent transposition, so a ladder is always a bijection (no two players collide).
- [공정한 추첨, 무엇으로 정할까](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-fair-draw.html): ladder vs roulette vs draw lots vs coin vs dice.
- [모임을 살리는 사다리타기 활용법](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-gathering.html)
- [왜 '랜덤'은 공정하게 느껴질까](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-procedural-fairness.html): procedural fairness psychology.
- [세계가 부르는 이름들](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-ladder-world.html): Sadari / Amidakuji / Ghost Leg / 鬼腳圖.
- [동전 던지기는 정말 50 대 50일까?](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-coin-fairness): coin-flip probability; a 2023 large study found ~50.8% same-side bias, but digital flips have no physical bias.
- [무작위란 무엇인가](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-randomness): true randomness vs pseudo-random (PRNG); SADARI uses the browser RNG, fair for draws.
- [공정한 조 편성의 기술](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-team-building): fair team formation (size/skill/relationship balance).
- [확률의 함정 — 도박사의 오류](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-gamblers-fallacy): gambler's fallacy, hot-hand, clustering illusion.
- [제비뽑기와 추첨, 세계의 풍습](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-draw-customs): sortition in ancient Athens, religious lots, omikuji, jury selection.
- [주사위의 역사와 확률](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-dice-history): dice history; why a sum of 7 is most likely with two dice.
- [회식비 정산의 에티켓](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-dutchpay-etiquette): bill-splitting etiquette (1/N vs random).
- [룰렛의 역사와 확률](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-roulette-history): roulette history (Pascal), European vs American wheel, house edge.
- [로또 확률의 진실](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-lottery-odds): lottery 6/45 odds (1/8,145,060), negative expected value.
- [결정 장애와 무작위](https://sa-da-ri.com/story-decision-fatigue): choice overload, decision fatigue, randomizing trivial choices.
- Hub: [사다리 이야기](https://sa-da-ri.com/stories.html)
